outcome: Composition of Lactobacillus communities in breast milk, maternal faeces, and infant faeces
Similarity between Lactobacillus communities across mother-infant pairs
cohort: 25 healthy mother-infant pairs in northwestern China, with infants aged from 7 days to 2 years.
finding: The infant gut Lactobacillus community was more similar to the maternal gut community than to breast milk, suggesting gut niche selection, but identical strains found across some mother-infant pairs supports vertical transfer via breastfeeding.
